edits.before: Orianna owns the early levels with her Command Attack ball poke and safe waveclear, but from levels 4-5 you edge ahead: Death Ray out-ranges her ball and lets you poke from outside her comfortable range. edits.before: Both ultimates are teamfight-defining rather than lane-kill tools, so 6 stays even in a 1v1. Command Shockwave punishes you if you group tightly, so respect it in skirmishes, and hold Chaos Storm and Gravity Field for when her jungler shows. Keep poking with E and don't hand her a ball-plus-shockwave engage.
